color.background.default.$description: Page background. The default, muted and faint foreground tokens are readable on it.

color.background.muted.$description: Quiet surface for sections, panels and containers. The default, muted and faint foreground tokens are readable on it.

color.background.emphasis.$description: Stronger surface for nested or emphasized areas, one step more contrast than muted. The default and muted foreground tokens are readable on it.

color.background.inverse.$description: Surface that is dark in Light mode and light in Dark mode (tooltips, inverted blocks). Pairs with foreground.inverse.

color.background.raised.$description: Surface of a component that floats above the page (card, popover, dropdown, dialog, sheet, toast). The same as the page in Light, one step lighter in Dark.

color.background.overlay.$description: Scrim colour behind a modal or sheet; applied at opacity.scrim, never opaque.

color.background.success-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the success role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.success-muted.

color.background.warning-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the warning role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.warning-muted.

color.background.danger-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the danger role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.danger-muted.

color.background.info-muted.$description: Quiet informational tint for alerts and highlights. Pairs with foreground.info-muted.

color.foreground.default.$description: Default text and icon colour for headings and body content. Readable on the page, muted, emphasis and raised backgrounds.

color.foreground.muted.$description: Quieter text for descriptions and captions. Readable on the page, muted, emphasis and raised backgrounds.

color.foreground.faint.$description: Faintest text for timestamps, metadata and hints. Readable on the page, muted and raised backgrounds.

color.foreground.primary.$description: Text and icons on the solid primary fill. Pairs with background.primary and background.primary-emphasis.

color.foreground.danger.$description: Text and icons on the solid danger fill. Pairs with background.danger and background.danger-emphasis.

color.foreground.success.$description: Text and icons on the solid success fill. Pairs with background.success and background.success-emphasis.

color.foreground.warning.$description: Dark text and icons on the solid warning fill (an amber fill cannot hold light text). Pairs with background.warning and background.warning-emphasis.

color.foreground.success-muted.$description: Success text on its tint (background.success-muted) and on the page.

color.foreground.warning-muted.$description: Warning text on its tint (background.warning-muted) and on the page.

color.foreground.danger-muted.$description: Danger text on its tint (background.danger-muted) and on the page.

color.foreground.info-muted.$description: Informational text on its tint (background.info-muted) and on the page.

color.foreground.primary-muted.$description: Primary text on its tint (background.primary-muted) and on the page.

color.border.default.$description: Default border for cards, inputs and containers.

color.border.emphasis.$description: Stronger border for control boundaries that need 3:1 against the page (inputs, checkboxes, switches).

color.border.focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring colour. Centralized: every component's focus indicator uses it.

color.border.success.$description: Border in the success colour for alerts, toasts and highlights.

color.border.warning.$description: Border in the warning colour for alerts, toasts and highlights.

color.border.danger.$description: Border in the danger colour for alerts, toasts and highlights.

color.background.primary.$description: Solid fill for the main action colour. Pairs with foreground.primary.

color.background.primary-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid primary fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.primary is readable on it.

color.background.success.$description: Solid fill for positive confirmation. Pairs with foreground.success.

color.background.success-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid success fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.success is readable on it.

color.background.warning.$description: Solid fill for caution. Pairs with foreground.warning.

color.background.warning-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid warning fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.warning is readable on it.

color.background.danger.$description: Solid fill for destructive actions and errors. Pairs with foreground.danger.

color.background.danger-emphasis.$description: Stronger tone of the solid danger fill. Components use it for hover and pressed states; foreground.danger is readable on it.

color.background.primary-muted.$description: Quiet tint of the primary role for alerts, badges and highlights. Pairs with foreground.primary-muted.

color.border.primary.$description: Accent border in the primary colour (cards, highlights, rings); non-text, so it needs 3:1 on the page.

shadow.base.$description: Default shadow for cards and raised elements

shadow.md.$description: Medium shadow for dropdowns and popovers

shadow.lg.$description: Large shadow for modals and overlays

shadow.xl.$description: Extra large shadow for maximum elevation

z-index.modal.$description: Modal dialogs, sheets, and similar blocking overlays

z-index.tooltip.$description: Tooltips — highest priority for transient hints

focus-ring.offset.$description: Offset of focus ring from element

z-index.popover.$description: Popovers, hover cards, and floating panels

opacity.scrim.$description: Heavy scrim opacity for modal backdrops

typography.font-size.display.lg.$description: Display Large — hero H1 at largest breakpoint (60px)

typography.font-size.display.md.$description: Display Medium — hero H1 at medium breakpoint (48px)

typography.font-size.display.sm.$description: Display Small — hero H1 base or section H2 large (36px)

typography.font-size.heading.lg.$description: Heading Large — section H2 base breakpoint (30px)

typography.font-size.heading.md.$description: Heading Medium — subheadings and prominent labels (24px)

typography.font-size.heading.sm.$description: Heading Small — card titles and feature item headings (20px)
